resources.string: Quick expense logging and balance overview
Who owes whom, with friends and on trips

Add anyone you split with — a name and a colour is all it takes, and they don\'t need the app. Splits, IOUs and settling up all work the same. Share a group only when you want them to see it on their own phone.
Make one for a trip or a flat. A shared group keeps everyone you invite in sync; join one with the code a friend sends.
Expenses and settlements stay in your history, without this group. Its member list is removed. This can\'t be undone.

Bills, statements and quick-add text are read by Google Gemini

That\'s how the app fills in amounts for you. While Kharcha Paani is free, Google may use what\'s sent to improve Gemini, and its reviewers may see it. It\'s never shown to other users, and we never sell your data. Prefer not to? Type entries yourself: everything else works the same.
